frozen_object.atlas_cutoff: seven deterministic rational initial seeds, twelve event steps, N<=8
frozen_object.avalanche: same-time closure in simultaneous recruitment waves; each newly recruited wave emits one further pulse and is index-sorted
frozen_object.clock: event count and exact rational transformed states; no arithmetic-prime clock
frozen_object.determinant_convention: no determinant; event words are source-local labels only
frozen_object.forbidden_data: target primes/zeros, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, target divisors, Hilbert-Polya operators
frozen_object.network: N identical oscillators with phase dot(phi)=1 on [0,1)
frozen_object.pulse: each firing sends epsilon in y=U coordinates; u decreases by c=(1-r)*epsilon and is clipped at r
frozen_object.transformed_coordinate: u=exp(-a*phi), r=exp(-a); threshold u=r and reset u=1

headline: An exact rational event-map and cluster-coarsening receipt for an all-to-all excitatory integrate-and-fire network.
nonclaims: The event receipt is a finite rational probe atlas for N<=8, seven seeds, and twelve events; it is not an exhaustive continuous-state cell census.
Almost-everywhere synchrony is not re-proved by the finite receipt; the cited theorem is used only under its stated hypotheses.
Tie hypersurfaces, epsilon=0, r->1, r->0, directed coupling and inhibitory pulses are boundary cases outside the frozen theorem.
Event words and the one-cycle return are source-local labels, not arithmetic primitive orbits, Euler factors, or a target determinant.
No arithmetic origin, automorphy, target functional equation, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

route_a.strongest_failure: no arithmetic carrier or target determinant; finite probes do not establish global synchrony beyond cited hypotheses
route_a.strongest_positive: exact rational event map, avalanche closure, partition coarsening and synchronized primitive event cycle

theorem.cluster_coarsening: Identical coordinates remain identical under common rescaling and common pulses; an avalanche resets its recruited set together, so the equality partition cannot refine.
theorem.event_map: In u coordinates free flight is u_i -> r*u_i/min_j(u_j); a pulse is u_j -> max(r,u_j-(1-r)epsilon), with avalanche closure by repeated firer pulses.
theorem.literature_scope: Mirollo-Strogatz almost-everywhere synchrony is cited under its hypotheses; the receipt separately certifies only the finite rational N<=8 probes and does not claim a complete continuous-state census.
theorem.primitive_cycle: The synchronized event word [N] has primitive period one; this is a source event cycle, not an arithmetic primitive orbit.
theorem.rationality: For rational r, epsilon and rational event states, every event and avalanche state is Fraction-exact; firing tests use equality/inequality over Q.
theorem.synchrony_absorption: The all-equal state u=(1,...,1) returns to itself after one all-N firing event and is an absorbing synchronized cluster.
